methodology: Tracked stocks from current membership, with owner-removed feeds excluded. This is not historical index membership. Missing bars are excluded, never filled. Price returns exclude dividends.
volume_methodology: Aggregate available constituent share volume, not index or ETF volume. Dollar turnover is close × provider share volume, a proxy rather than actual cash inflows. Split-adjusted provider prices/volumes are used together. Zero/missing volume is excluded; totals are not extrapolated. Up/down requires consecutive closes; flat and unclassified volume remain in the total.
